title: Closed Euclidean balls have Lebesgue measure at most (2r)^k (printed ω_k r^k, erratum ω_k ≤ 2^k)
statement: Let ι be a finite index set with k := |ι| elements and E := ℝ^ι = EuclideanSpace ℝ ι with its Euclidean distance |w − c| = (Σ_{i∈ι}(w_i − c_i)²)^{1/2} and Lebesgue measure L^k (Mathlib's volume on E). For every c ∈ E and every real r ≥ 0, the closed ball B̄_r(c) = {w ∈ E : |w − c| ≤ r} satisfies L^k(B̄_r(c)) ≤ (2r)^k, as an inequality in [0, ∞], i.e. L^k(B̄_r(c)) ≤ ofReal((2r)^k).
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → volume (closedBall c r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ Fintype.card ι)
